safety_gates.name: stop_primitive_available
safety_gates.detail: Coordinator must expose async_stop_manual_motion().

safety_gates.name: ble_transport_required
safety_gates.detail: Real closed-loop motion requires the BLE transport for responsive telemetry; cloud/Wi-Fi lag is unsafe for guarded path execution. BLE must also report itself usable -- being selected for routing does not mean a command can be delivered.

safety_gates.name: ble_link_live
safety_gates.detail: Real motion requires a conservative BLE preflight -- a live client, an open dispatch gate, an empty command queue, and a recent outbound attempt. 'Usable' only means BLE is eligible for routing; it stays True while the command queue is gated and commands (including the mandatory stop that bounds a pulse) accumulate undelivered. The send path separately waits for confirmed queue start and GATT-write completion. See docs/pymammotion-ble-slot-leak-bug.md.

safety_gates.name: operator_confirmed_blades_off
safety_gates.detail: Real pulse requires confirm_blades_off=true.

safety_gates.name: operator_confirmed_clear_area
safety_gates.detail: Real pulse requires confirm_clear_area=true.

safety_gates.name: mower_reports_blades_off
safety_gates.detail: Real pulse requires blade state and cutter mode off. A nonzero latched RPM register is discounted only after three samples prove the position feed live and the RPM constant.

safety_gates.name: mower_ready
safety_gates.detail: Real pulse requires the mower to be ready/paused, not mowing or charging.

safety_gates.name: not_docked_or_charging
safety_gates.detail: Real pulse requires the mower to be off the dock and not charging.

safety_gates.name: live_map_position_available
safety_gates.detail: Real pulse requires live map-local mower position.

safety_gates.name: position_area_inside
safety_gates.detail: Real pulse requires AREA_INSIDE, TURN_AREA_INSIDE, or CHANNEL_AREA_OVERLAP and a nonzero known zone hash.

safety_gates.name: map_position_nonzero
safety_gates.detail: Real pulse requires nonzero map-local x/y coordinates.

safety_gates.name: corridor_polygon_valid
safety_gates.detail: The frozen corridor must be a real polygon, >= 3 vertices.

safety_gates.name: frozen_start_inside_corridor
safety_gates.detail: The frozen route start itself must be inside the frozen corridor.

safety_gates.name: start_drift_within_bound
safety_gates.detail: Live position must be within 0.3 m of the frozen route start. The start is never re-derived from live position -- this gate aborts instead.

safety_gates.name: blind_heading_acquisition_contained
safety_gates.detail: No opening toward value is trusted. A complete disk around the live start must fit the frozen corridor before the mower may drive straight to derive a fresh position-chord course: 0.28 m/s for 2.0 s plus 0.5 m stopping/guard overshoot.
